projects.title: SmarTown 3D GIS
projects.description: Web GIS platform for 2D and 3D map studies, spatial analytics, and asset intelligence.
projects.longDescription: SmarTown 3D GIS is a comprehensive geospatial intelligence platform designed for municipal asset management, infrastructure planning, and advanced spatial analytics. Built to handle massive geospatial datasets, the system renders highly performant 2D vector layers and rich 3D digital twins in real time. It enables engineers, planners, and decision-makers to visualize spatial relationships, query infrastructure attributes, and perform site-suitability analysis directly in the browser.
features: Interactive 3D digital twins with detailed mesh and terrain modeling.
Real-time asset intelligence and utility network mapping.
Advanced spatial querying (buffers, intersections, and proximity tools).
Performant rendering of massive point cloud and 3D tiles datasets.
Integrated geospatial workflows for municipal reporting and planning.
